TERRA NOVA: FREEFALL - RELEASE NOTES
====================================

1.2 - AI IMPROVEMENTS
---------------------
- New option AI: Classic or Fixed (Gameplay page). Classic is the
  game's AI exactly as it is. Fixed repairs twelve programming
  mistakes in the 1996 AI (G49 to G60 in BUGS.txt):
  - each squad mate aims with its own skill (all used the first one's);
  - squad mates keep the Autodoc until their suit is below half, and the
    explosive drone until below three quarters (they used them at the
    first scratch);
  - "Use ASF Now" no longer ends "Use ASF at Will";
  - enemies with several weapons use their better weapons more often
    and hit somewhat harder, most in the later missions; squad mates
    choose as before;
  - an enemy squad that a shot passes reacts when it can see who fired
    (it looked for the player, whoever fired);
  - soldiers under fire move sooner, targets are chosen by kind and then
    distance, aircraft attack the nearest soldier, a squad counts its
    damaged units as damaged, and a blocked squad waits as long at 60
    frames a second as at 25.
  The difficulty levels and the squads' tactics are the game's own.
- AI: Improved, the option's third value: the fixes of Fixed, and new
  behaviour (the game plays differently from 1996 with it):
  - enemy soldiers that see you and have a clear shot hold at the
    distance of their weapon instead of walking up to you;
  - enemy soldiers under half health take cover out of your line of
    fire instead of standing until they die;
  - an enemy soldier that is hit steps 2 squares sideways, across your
    line of fire;
  - an enemy soldier that lost sight of you searches around the place
    it last saw you and then gives up (the 1996 soldier was told where
    you are two times in seven);
  - squad mates step out of your line of fire, squads stand 2 squares
    apart instead of in one heap, and squad mates in formation no
    longer take a place in front of your gun when they fight;
  - squad mates prefer an enemy that no other squad mate is already
    shooting at.
- The presets set the AI: Classic in the Classic preset, Fixed in
  Vanilla+, Improved in Freefall. A tnfree.ini of an earlier version
  keeps its AI setting (its preset reads Custom until you pick a preset
  again).
- New option Visor damage (Mods page, with Widescreen and a cockpit
  mod; On in the Freefall preset): the suit's damage shows on the
  visor's glass, in the cockpit and the goggles of the Scout, standard
  and Heavy suits: shrapnel hits, a laser's burn or cracks, each in
  three styles; a mission picks two kinds and a style of each. The
  first appears when the armour falls to 73%, the second at 50%; at 37%
  one turns heavy and at 20% the other, each step with a short flash.
- Fixed a crash when a tree or bush burned inside the area of a base's
  building (Burning plants; seen in Operation Oilslick).
- Mission Selector: Outfit Complete clicked right after the outfitting
  screen came up skipped the launch video; it plays now.
- Arms pack: the frame rate could fall to about 20 in goggles view on
  some processors; fixed.
- Soldiers, trees and bushes no longer show through a hill inside a
  base's area, as at the fuel tanks of Operation Oilslick (G61).
- A crash fixed when a soldier got beyond the edge of the map (P155).
- A crash fixed when a blast hit a unit with no armour record whose
  part was already destroyed (G62).
- Show FPS also writes its numbers into tnfree.log every 5 seconds in a
  mission.

1.1 - EXTRA MISSIONS
--------------------
- The Mission Selector has a new list, Extra Missions, for missions that
  are not part of the game's campaign.
- The four missions of the two 1996 demos play in the full game:
  Operations Madison, Brickdragger, Flashlight and Citadel, with the
  demos' own briefings, squads, goals and debriefings. Freefall reads them
  from the demo folders of your copy of the game (TNDEMO1 and TNDEMO2; the
  Steam release has them). See EXTRA MISSIONS in README.txt.
- Operation Stone Henge, a fan-made mission by Joerg Fischer (1999) for
  the first demo, with his permission: made in memory from your own demo
  and game files.
- Two lost missions from the game's CD, which the installer never
  copied: an earlier version of Operation Panama, and Operation
  Bricklayer, a test mission the developers left behind.
- After an extra mission you are back on the Extra Missions list, with
  that mission chosen.
- The Freefall options screen has two new buttons: ABORT MISSION and EXIT
  TERRA NOVA. The game asks first, as on its own options screen. The
  button for the game's own options screen is now called CLASSIC OPTIONS.
- Infrared: Sci-fi no longer shows the old orange infrared for a moment
  when it is switched on or off.
- Infrared: Sci-fi tunes in when you switch it on: 0.2 seconds of torn
  rows and faint static that settle into the thermal view, and 0.1
  seconds of the same when you switch it off.
- The head view cone on the minimap no longer flashes in other colours
  for a frame when the infrared goes on or off.
- With a cockpit mod, the game's "Abort Mission?" and "Exit Terra Nova?"
  box has its black background again in a mission (the 3D view showed
  through it).
- General MIDI: Freefall now resets the MIDI device fully when the music
  starts. A device left in an odd state by another program could play the
  music with sounds missing.

1.0 - INITIAL RELEASE
---------------------
- Terra Nova: Strike Force Centauri runs natively on modern Windows,
  without DOSBox, from your own Steam or GOG copy of the game.
- Three presets: Classic (the DOS game as it was), Vanilla+ (modern
  controls, the classic look) and Freefall (every improvement on).
- Widescreen with 16:9 cockpits and goggles for every suit, sharp 3D up to
  6 times the original resolution, 60 frames a second.
- Modern controls: mouse look, auto-aim, keys you can rebind, a new help
  screen (H).
- Freefall Mod Pack included: new cockpits with a helmet that moves, your
  suit's arms, new explosions and effects, trees, bushes and rocks.
- Music: the soundtrack recorded as MP3 by Rich "Weeds" Nagel, SoundFont
  music with GeneralUser GS, the Sound Blaster's FM music, General MIDI.
- Mission Selector, a built-in benchmark, movies smoothed to 30 pictures a
  second.
- 48 bugs of the original game fixed (Docs\BUGS.txt lists them all).

Everything can be switched on the options screen (O in a mission, or
Freefall Options on the main menu). README.txt explains every option.
